data.name: Duyansh
data.gender_notes: Duyansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit roots ‘duh’ (difficult) and ‘yash’ (to win, triumph). This name signifies someone who overcomes challenges and emerges victorious. It is a powerful and invincible name for a baby boy. The name Duyansh carries the meaning “Powerful, Invincible” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Duyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, invincible and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies spiritual strength and triumph over challenges.
data.etymology: Duyansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Invincible.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Duyansh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: The Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic contains a mention of a Yadava prince named Duyansh. He was a descendant of Krishna and a contemporary of the Pandava prince Bhima. This suggests a time period around the 4th or 5th century BC.
